metadata.license_source: Original source and wheel distribution metadata retained

activation: Use bin/retrowrite-python for the independent Python import environment.
notes: Original CPG 0.21.14 package lifecycle. Candidate overlay; no automatic mainline qualification.
usage.summary: Use bin/retrowrite INPUT_ELF OUTPUT.s and gcc -pie OUTPUT.s -o OUTPUT. Bounded acceptance is x86-64 non-stripped PIE C programs only. ARM64, stripped/non-PIE input, C++, ASan/AFL passes, and kernel rewriting are not qualified. Upstream source is preserved; dependencies are exact official wheels. Requires Python 3.12 and gcc/binutils.
